text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The deserted island project was making 
steady progress!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if the maze is a bit too easy. 
Once you do it a few times, you end up 
memorizing it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I think the course for training speed 
could be even bigger!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"How about we switch to heavier diving 
coins? Or maybe even something as heavy as 
dumbbells!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Mhm, mhm... Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Tucker-san! We've gathered quite a lot of 
everyone's feedback!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my bad, thanks Chiyono O! Your notes 
are always so easy to read, it's a huge 
help!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
And, Trainer <username>! Do you have anything to 
add!?
choice_data_list: Indeed. As for the coins, for example—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pioneering gave way to construction, 
leading into days filled with continuous 
refinement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Then, one day at Tracen Academy――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if it'll be okay.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm! I was just a little curious about 
that girl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Mejiro Ryan pointed, there 
was an Umamusume crouching past the finish 
line, her face contorted with frustration.

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*...!! Ugh, come on, my 
time dropped again...! Why...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I began to see her like that quite often 
from then on—

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
34, 35... gah, nnnngh! Argh, come on! 
Why... This is no different from 
yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
*cough, cough-cough*! Haaah... No good. 
I'm too slow...!

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *gasp*, *wheeze*! *pant*!! Time... 
Time out——...!!

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I can't take this anymore... It's so 
stupid...! There's no way someone like 
me... could ever beat her—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu, go call out to them. Don't be 
shy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? B-But look, it's not like someone 
like me could do anything for you, you 
know...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry about it! I really think 
there are things only Ryan-chan can pull 
off."

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Is this... the rumored Tracen Island!? 
Whoa, so this is what it looks like.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
We're taking part in this development 
project, and right now we're testing out 
this training facility!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Um... I want as many girls as possible to 
try it out and give feedback, you see! 
I-If you'd like, how about you try it 
too!?

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "I don't mind, but... Why me?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, umm, you see...! Like, I just 
happened to be in the right place at the 
right time, or—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, don't sweat the small stuff♪ Go 
on, go play along with Ryan-chan!

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"—*pant*, *gasp*! *wheeze*! That was 
close! Seriously, that was way too 
h-hardcore...!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah―― Watch your step! Stay focused and 
come this way first...!

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes! Next is—whoa! Whoaa~!! Focus, 
focus~~!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp, wheeze, gasp*...! F-Finally 
halfway there...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"It's totally fine! For the rest of the 
course, just forget all the bad stuff and 
focus entirely on running—it'll be easy!"

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Ryan-san. I've been thinking while 
working together with you—

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You didn't just invite me here because I 
happened to be standing in the right 
place, did you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Wh-Why... !?

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I get completely absorbed in 
something, she just smiles, telling me to 
forget about the bad stuff and all.

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling you're trying to cheer 
me up... I-It'd be pretty embarrassing if 
that was just my imagination, though!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Well, umm... ...Yeah, that's right. 
Sorry for acting on my own.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...Seeing her compare herself to others 
and get all down on herself just made me 
want to butt in."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I went through a phase like that too. 
Comparing myself to other girls and 
getting down... ...things not going well, 
letting it rot away at me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Even racing, which was supposed to be fun, 
turned into something I hated... ...It was 
painful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So I just wanted to help broaden her 
horizons even a little. ...Well, Ines was 
the one who really gave me the push, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hup! See? This facility really makes the 
most of the great outdoors, don't you 
think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's wild, dangerous—and pushing right to 
the very edge!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant*, it's so tough I'm getting 
dizzy! I don't have... any room to spare!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haa, that's why it's so easy to lose 
myself in it. To the point where I forget 
everything, absolutely everything...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So――whoops, from here on, it's a race! 
Toryaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah! P-Please wait!

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text: W-Wah wah, look out! W-Wait, Ryan-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: No, I won't wait! You catch up to me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*! *pant*! Ahhh, that's my limit...! 
*cough, cough*!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, you've got a great look on your 
face. —Alright, good work, good work~! Did 
you have fun?

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*, *gasp*... Um... While I 
was running all-out just now, I remembered 
something.

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I realized that I truly love running— 
that I love racing...!

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I feel like... I can keep giving 
it my all a little longer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Ehehe, thank goodness!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Fumu――'Remembered my passion for racing,' 
'Want to challenge even harder things'!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Feedback born from first-time experience 
is truly precious. Thank you, Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
N-No! All's well that ends well. I wasn't 
thinking that far ahead when I invited 
you!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
No, even so, I can see the path forward! A 
wider variety of opinions is indispensable 
for polishing it further!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
In other words—I've got it! Let's put out 
a huge call for testers!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Testers wanted for Island Training! Kick 
off your summer training camp on Tracen 
Island!" ...Aaaand done! Yep, looks great!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp on Tracen Island...! 
Hehe, I can't wait~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The deserted island project progresses 
even further!
